source.publisher: Fermanagh Herald (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: Returned unopposed after withdrawals: the nominations list shows two candidates in this division, but the Herald of 21 May 1927 reports contests in only Holywell, Irvinestown and Monea, leaving this division uncontested.

note: Triennial election of Fermanagh County Council, polled Wednesday 25 May 1927 (Fermanagh Herald, 21 May 1927: 'The Local Government Elections will take place in Co. Fermanagh on Wednesday next, 25th May'). Three divisions were contested; the other seventeen divisions were uncontested; the Herald of 30 April 1927 prints the nominations and the winners are those left after withdrawals. Results declared at Enniskillen on Thursday 2 June (Fermanagh Herald, 4 June 1927). Structure and division names for the 1966-67 amalgamation are in notes/fermanagh-fcra-1969.md, from Fermanagh CRA, 'Fermanagh Facts' (1969). That is an advocacy pamphlet: use it for names only, not figures. Its register figures are disputed by Kingsley (2021) on the Omagh Rural District scheme. Read the page image before recording any number from it. Returned unopposed.
